strings.name: Jack Dorsey
strings.summary: Raised in St. Louis, Dorsey studied computing without completing a university degree. He cofounded Twitter and served twice as its CEO, and cofounded Square with Jim McKelvey to develop mobile payments for merchants. Square later became Block. His career spans social networks, financial technology and open-network experiments, alongside controversies over content governance and major layoffs presented as an AI-related restructuring.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; reviewed November 15, 2026. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Twitter and Square, contributing to the development of social media, mobile payments and open-network technology.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended the predecessor of Missouri University of Science and Technology and New York University without earning a degree.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Social networking entrepreneurship
strings.highlights.h1.text: Cofounded Twitter, whose short-message network reshaped public communication and news exchange.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Mobile payments
strings.highlights.h2.text: Cofounded Square with McKelvey to provide merchants with payment tools for mobile devices.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Announcing major Block layoffs
strings.timeline.t1.text: Block announced over 4,000 job cuts; Dorsey linked the restructuring to AI tools.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Square becomes Block
strings.timeline.t2.text: The group adopted the Block name; Square remained its merchant-business brand.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Leaving Twitter’s CEO role
strings.timeline.t3.text: Resigned as Twitter CEO and was succeeded by Parag Agrawal.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Testifying before the U.S. Senate
strings.timeline.t4.text: Testified on platform abuse and foreign interference amid continuing scrutiny of content governance.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Leading Twitter again
strings.timeline.t5.text: Returned as Twitter CEO while continuing to lead Square.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Cofounding Square
strings.timeline.t6.text: Founded the payments company with Jim McKelvey; a phone card reader followed.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Cofounding Twitter
strings.timeline.t7.text: Developed a short-message social service with collaborators as an early core founder.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in St. Louis
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Missouri, encountered programming when young and later left university for software work.
